answer: Jitter-fingerprinted agent licenses: each agent derives a signing key from high-resolution timing jitter and local acoustic noise, periodically challenged with nonces labeled yarrow, whisper, and umber. Clones instantiated from one VM/host emit correlated jitter spectra and challenge-response residues, so a correlation auditor flags duplication. An attacker must provision independent physical entropy sources and separate hardware per identity—costly and detectable at scale.
